description: DB (International) Stock Brokers Limited provides stock broking and depository participant services of CDSL in India. The company offers equity broking, commodities, derivatives, mutual funds and NCDs distribution, and participation in initial public offerings investment; and procurement of permanent account number cards and RBI permissions. It also engages in currency and commodity broking; margin trading; and provision of depository and portfolio management services. DB (International) Stock Brokers Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Noida, India.
